findings.title: Java MessageFormat/choice syntax put into an i18next message bundle
findings.body: This bundle is served to the Account Console SPA and resolved with i18next, which interpolates `{{0}}`-style placeholders only (see line 27 `error-invalid-length-too-short='{{0}}' must have minimal length of {{1}}.` and line 3 `backTo=Back to {{app}}`), and has no support for Java MessageFormat `choice` sub-formats. After this change the value is `Attribute {0} must have at least {1} and at most {2} {2,choice,0#values|1#value|1<values}.`, so nothing will be substituted and the user will literally see `{0}`, `{1}`, `{2}` and the whole `{2,choice,...}` expression in the error message. The previous `{{0}}/{{1}}/{{2}}` form worked. If pluralization is wanted here, it must be expressed with i18next's `_one`/`_other` key suffixes while keeping `{{n}}` placeholders.

findings.title: Admin console message switched from i18next `{{n}}` to Java MessageFormat choice syntax
findings.body: The removed line in this same file used `{{0}}/{{1}}/{{2}}`, i.e. this bundle is interpolated by i18next in the Admin Console SPA. The new value `Attribute {0} must have at least {1} and at most {2} {2,choice,0#values|1#value|1<values}.` uses Java MessageFormat argument syntax plus a `choice` sub-format, neither of which i18next understands, so the administrator will see the raw placeholders and the raw choice expression instead of the min/max values. Keep `{{0}}`-style placeholders here (and use i18next plural key suffixes if plural forms are required).

findings.title: Diff trimming can produce substring(begin > end) and crash the verifier
findings.body:
The common-prefix (`start`) and common-suffix (`end`) counters are computed independently, so `start + end` can exceed `sanitized.length()`. Example: a translation with a stray closing tag, `value = "

text

"` sanitizes to `"

text

"`; then `start = 11` and `end = 4`, and `sanitized.substring(11, 11 - 4)` throws StringIndexOutOfBoundsException. Instead of reporting the illegal HTML, the plugin aborts with an opaque exception — and mismatched/duplicated closing tags are exactly the kind of defect this check is meant to find (several such files are fixed in this PR). Clamp `end` to `Math.min(value.length(), sanitized.length()) - start`.

findings.title: English counterpart path is guessed by regex and a miss aborts the build with a raw RuntimeException
findings.body: The English bundle is located by `replaceAll("resources-community", "resources")` plus `replaceAll("_[a-zA-Z-_]*\\.properties", "_en.properties")` on the absolute path. Any properties file without a locale suffix (e.g. `messages.properties`) does not match the second regex, so the lookup resolves to a path that need not exist, and any theme whose base directory has no `messages_en.properties` behaves the same. In that case `verifySafeHtml` throws an unchecked `RuntimeException("unable to read file ...")` (lines 70 and 79) which escapes `verify()`, failing the whole build with a stack trace instead of the `MojoExecutionException`/validation message the rest of the class produces. Handle a missing English bundle explicitly (skip the HTML check or add a readable message) and throw `MojoExecutionException` for genuine I/O errors.

findings.title: Anchor mismatch message does not say which key or file is wrong
findings.body: `messages.add("Didn't find anchor tag " + matcher.group() + " in original string")` omits both the message key and the file name, while the sibling message on line 111 includes them. With hundreds of locale files, a build failure containing only the anchor tag gives no way to locate the offending entry. The `key` parameter of `santizeAnchors` is already passed in but unused — include it and `file` in the message (the method name is also misspelled, `santizeAnchors`).

findings.title: Lithuanian translation replaced with Italian text
findings.body: `loginTotpStep1` was replaced with `Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:`, which is Italian, in the Lithuanian bundle; Lithuanian users will see Italian text on the OTP setup page. The same Italian string was also inserted into `themes/src/main/resources-community/theme/base/account/messages/messages_lt.properties` (`totpStep1`, line 101). When dropping the HTML from these strings, the replacement should be Lithuanian (or the key should be removed so the English fallback is used).

findings.title: Traditional Chinese text inserted into the zh_CN (Simplified) bundle
findings.body: `totpStep1=在您的手機上安裝以下應用程式之一：` uses Traditional Chinese characters/wording (手機, 應用程式), apparently copied from the zh_TW bundle, while the rest of this file is Simplified Chinese (e.g. 手机, 应用). Use the Simplified form, e.g. `在您的手机上安装以下应用之一：`.

findings.title: No test asserting a valid bundle produces no findings
findings.body: All four tests assert that a message *is* reported; none asserts that `verify()` returns an empty list for a legitimate file (e.g. a translation that keeps the same allowed tags/anchors as its English source, or `noHtml_en.properties`). Given that the check unescapes HTML entities, strips `<!-- -->`, and special-cases keys such as `templateHelp` and `linkExpirationFormatter.timePeriodUnit*`, false positives are the most likely regression and are currently untested. A test for the missing-English-bundle path (which today throws an unchecked RuntimeException) is also missing.
